cases.customer_question: What is a TCW and when can it be used during Bluetooth SIG registration?
question_variants: Meaning of TCW in Bluetooth SIG
TCW number shown instead of Yes/No
How do TCWs resolve registration issues?
cases.actual_issue: The customer encountered TCW identifiers in the registration system and needed to understand their purpose in the qualification workflow.
cases.plain_english_explanation: TCWs are Bluetooth SIG mechanisms related to unresolved inter-layer dependency conditions within the qualification system. They provide a controlled path for submission when a dependency issue is attributable to the SIG side and requires review.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that TCWs are associated with Inter-Layer Dependencies. When a dependency issue cannot be resolved through normal qualification processing and the issue is attributable to the SIG-side dependency framework, an applicable TCW may be entered to allow submission subject to review and approval.
cases.decision_logic: TCWs are exception-handling mechanisms used only for specific dependency situations recognized by the Bluetooth SIG qualification process.
cases.final_recommendation: Review the applicable Inter-Layer Dependencies guidance and use a TCW only when the qualification issue matches an approved TCW condition.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Misunderstanding TCWs can lead to incorrect submission planning, unresolved dependency issues, and delays in registration review.
